page.layout: Title "Locorum Scripturæ." across the top at full width; below it two parallel columns of a table (left: Cap. | Verf. | Pag.; right: Cap. | Verf. | Pag.), separated by a double vertical rule; below the columns at the foot a signature "Oooo 3" centred under the right-hand part and "Verf4" at the right-hand edge. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Locorum Scripturæ.
main_text.l: Cap. | Verf. | Pag. || Cap. | Verf. | Pag.

page.notes: Table is set in two parallel columns, transcribed row by row; the left column's "Cap." entries are IV, V, VI, VII and the right column's are VII, VIII, IX. Some numerals are doubtful in the faded scan (e.g. "1207", "1000", "1064", "15,225,227.557", "14.12"), and the scan is damaged at the page edges. The header "Verf4" at the foot is read as "Verfa", a catchword-like signature; it is printed as "Verf41." on the scan.
